snapshot: WHO Western Pacific Region. Universal health insurance since 1961, and a leading advocate of universal health coverage in global health diplomacy; Tokyo hosts the UHC Knowledge Hub.

leadership.role: Minister of Health, Labour and Welfare
leadership.name: Kenichiro Ueno

agenda.title: UHC Knowledge Hub
agenda.text: At the UHC High-Level Forum in Tokyo on 6 December 2025, Prime Minister Takaichi said Japan will work with the World Bank, WHO and like-minded partners to support the UHC Knowledge Hub, launched that day. It trains finance and health officials in developing countries on sustainable health financing; eight Asian and African countries joined the first-year training. Japan wants the forum to shape global health beyond 2030.

agenda.title: Third Health and Medical Strategy (FY2025-2029)
agenda.text: The cabinet approved the third term of the strategy in February 2025. It adds an integrated project on infectious diseases (vaccines, therapeutics and diagnostics, including world-class vaccine R&D hubs) and one on faster clinical trials, with a target of more than 80% of multicentre trials under single-IRB review within eight years from 2026.
